What phenomenon is shown in this image?

![Prism Light Refraction](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Prism_rainbow_schema.png)
questions.explain: This is **Dispersion**. White light separates into its constituent colors (spectrum) when passing through a prism because different wavelengths refract by different amounts.
